_about: Sidecar for topic_bank.json. trending = dated/news topic; stale_risk = how fast the facts may go out of date. Re-verify every HIGH item on publish day. Picker expiry (valid_until) lives in data/current_market_topics.json: after that instant the topic is not boosted and not picked. A YYYY-MM-DD value includes that whole IST day.
